_comment: GAP 1 -- FROZEN BUT READABLE. Identical to healthy.json's ledger in every respect a floor can see: 300 entries across 8 distinct agent lanes, read successfully, well-formed. The only difference is that the newest entry is DAYS old, meaning the ledger stopped accepting writes. Every size floor passes forever in this state, because a frozen collection never shrinks -- it stays identical. This is the same AGE-not-FLOOR blind spot that let a frozen search index sit undetected for ~12 days, and it is the direct analogue of the 2026-08-17/18 incident: a broken WRITE path sitting behind a perfectly healthy READ. This fixture must FAIL on ledger_freshness while passing both ledger floors.
